::: {#def-pretraining}

#### Pretraining

**Pretraining** trains a network on a large body of text whose targets come from the text itself,
before [fine-tuning](cnns.qmd#def-fine-tuning) it on a task with labels.
@radford2018improving [section 3.1] pretrain a Transformer with a [causal mask](#def-causal-mask) to predict each next token.
@devlin2019bert [section 3.1] pretrain one without a mask to predict tokens hidden from its input,
choosing 15% of the positions at random.

:::
